vessels.title: Heirloom pattern
vessels.description: Fleur-de-lis engraving with a QR marker and the line "A Lifetime of Love".

vessels.title: Floral wreath
vessels.description: Roses, doves and rings frame the QR marker, with a name or brand below.

vessels.title: Fully custom pair
vessels.description: Constellation and monogram designs, each engraved with names, a date and a QR marker.

vessels.title: Minimal
vessels.description: A clean, quiet vessel with only a QR marker and a name.

interfaces.title: Welcome page
interfaces.description: A personalized landing page introduces the couple and guides guests to the activities.

interfaces.title: Shared album
interfaces.description: Guests add candid photos from their own phones to a private wedding album.

interfaces.title: Digital guestbook
interfaces.description: A message and optional photo, later organized into a printed or digital keepsake.

interfaces.title: Wedding party poll
interfaces.description: A playful prompt such as "Most likely to start the dance floor", revealed later.

colors.title: Ceramic color options
colors.description: Charcoal, terracotta, ivory and blush. Colors may be mixed within the 10-vessel minimum.
